scope: Behavior, ARIA, parts, events and state attributes of the web component in happy-dom (node:test), and the React renderer's server markup and client behavior. Rendered lengths are covered by the browser geometry check and the React parity check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: items, header and region parts, single and multiple modes, value / default-value / seeded open, change (cancelable, reason trigger-press), disabled, arrow / Home / End focus, no native form elements
resolveDisclosure: trigger row, panel insets, the 1px divider and the closed item height
React SSR: the same data-* as the web component on host, items, headers, triggers and panels; composed parts render the preset items; onValueChange / onOpenChange details; keyboard focus

limitations: The panel height animation needs a real browser; unit tests cover the attributes it keys on.
React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html ("fails": []).

Geometry review, manual items (2026-11-02, studio at u = 2, 3, the theme unit 4.5 and 6, B = 0 and 1, light and dark): growth (long labels wrap and grow their trigger; the divider stays 1px), RTL (dir=rtl mirrors the triggers; horizontal arrow keys are mirrored), focus (the outline ring never changes an item's size), screenshots of the Disclosure family checked light and dark.
